format: Pagination fixtures for the order of the rules in 02 section 9.4 (FE-082). Every page is 50 units tall with no margins and every line is 10 units, so a page holds five lines. An item is a paragraph with a line count and the flags it sets, or a page break. An expected page lists its pieces as block:firstLine-endLine (end exclusive). The expectations were worked out by hand from the rules, not copied from the output of the code. keepNext against widow control follows owner decision 178 (docs/owner-decisions-2026-11-15.md) and ADR 0120 item 4.

cases.why: A keepNext chain does not cross an explicit page break.
A pageBreakBefore right after an explicit break makes no blank page.
A pageBreakBefore at the top of a page makes no blank page.
The heading cannot keep with a paragraph that starts a page.
Room for the heading but not for its first line of text: the heading moves.
A chain moves as one with a keepLines terminal: the heading and all three lines need 40, the page has 30 left.
Owner decision 178: the heading and the first line of the paragraph stay together even though widow control would move the whole paragraph.
The paragraph that keeps its lines together moves whole, where widow control alone would split it.
Three lines fit; leaving one line for the next page is a widow, so two go on the first page.
Only one line fits at the bottom, which is an orphan, so the paragraph moves whole.
With no rule set the paragraph fills the page and continues.
The first two headings and the text need 70 against a page of 50, so that chain is broken after the first heading. The second heading with its text needs 40 and 10 are left, so it moves.
